title: Verified correction loop, scoped repair and repeated-error prevention
whatBuilt: CLASSIFIED NOT ASSUMED: every reported correction is VERIFIED through a domain verifier seam and classified confirmed_error | false_correction | valid_preference; false corrections are recorded and REFUSED repair; valid preferences recorded with nothing repaired
SCOPED REPAIR: repairs bind to (domain, ref) + exact artifact digest; invalidate ONLY the affected revision (other domains/earlier revisions untouched); append-only repair history, inspectable
UNAUTHORIZED EDITS REJECTED: cross-owner refused; reviewer role may act on any ref; repairs require a VERIFIED confirmed error for the exact digest
RECURRENCE TESTED: repeated confirmed errors increment recurrence and escalate to human review after the pre-declared bound — loop closes bounded (never unbounded)
INVALIDATION: is_stale fails dependent artifacts closed against an invalidated revision until regenerated
DOMAINS: memory | ocr | explanation | build (verifier seams; real verification wires to each domain's authority)

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 186/186 pass (177 previous + 9 corrections)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: The domain verifiers are SEAMS; wiring them to the real memory/OCR/explanation/Build authorities is integration work. Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
